notes: Dialogue has life again. Lines had gone flat (only commas and periods) while the action lines next to them showed the feeling. Now the size of a reaction still stays in proportion, but every spoken line carries the speaker's feeling in its own words and punctuation: ! for warmth or surprise, ? for questions, ... for hesitating, "Hehe", "Hm?", "Oops!". Dracaene especially: composed, but warm and bright when she talks, not a monotone.
